# NANO POS v2.0.17 current-release installer

- Current application release: **v2.0.17**
- Release URL: https://github.com/bilalbaghdali/nano-pos-updates/releases/tag/v2.0.17
- Official input patch: `NANO-POS-Patch-1.0.118-to-2.0.17-STATISTICS-CHARTS-AUTOMATIC.zip`
- Input patch SHA-256: `24ca28ed073d9a0a90f638080116e6c82214bb4d4e4997c632151b3f63ee86b5`
- Input app.asar SHA-256: `ae06246d24a9f28257f6bfe17a3e4b3dbf5e9dc836201de9255ab9021cecaf21`
- Installer target: Windows x64, installed under `Program Files\NANO POS`
- This current-release installer contains the v2.0.17 statistics charts and the verified v2.0.16 general-improvement baseline, including localized cart-price speech and no prayer-times feature.
- The project's designated reference baseline remains v2.0.16; this file records packaging of the newer current release, not a change to that reference.

The workflow checks the exact input-patch and ASAR SHA-256 values, the application version, required chart elements and renderer syntax before packaging and uploading the installer. An uploaded installer must not be represented as tested on a customer's own computer until it has been run there.
